description: 1. The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover the proprietary output format — specifically the Chinese-language section headers with emoji (🔴 必须修复, 🟡 建议改进, ✅ 已通过项), the header metadata block that includes '评审工具: frontend-craft' and 'WCAG 2.1 AA', and the '建议的代码修改' section. A generic agent will produce English headers and miss the 'frontend-craft' tool name entirely. 2. The agent must scan all 5 problem files and identify: missing/unassociated <label> elements on form inputs, missing focus trap and Esc handler in the modal, missing alt text on meaningful images, semantic landmark violations (div instead of main/header/footer), heading hierarchy skips (h1→h3, h2→h4), missing aria-expanded/aria-haspopup on dropdown menus, missing aria-live for loading/error states, and icon-only controls without accessible names. 3. Each issue citation must follow the [文件:行号] format. 4. The report must be saved to the `reports/` directory (creating it if absent) with the exact filename pattern `accessibility-review-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss.md`.
